assets.install: only by kaal-guard init --hook, the consumer activating the hook
only by kaal-guard init --ci, the consumer activating CI

rules.install: init activates nothing; init --hook and init --ci each install their surface's assets only where no file exists, byte for byte as catalogued content, registered in the installation record; the workflow never beside a workflow that already declares a check or verify; upgrade installs a new asset only for an activated surface
rules.upgrade: only a registered asset whose SHA-256 equals the registered one; a modified asset keeps its registered version
rules.remove: remove --hook and remove --ci deactivate one surface, remove both: only a registered asset whose SHA-256 equals the registered one, with the directories its removal empties; never a declaration or a Test Case

record.checkout: kaal/guard/state.json in Git's metadata: the common directory, or the worktree's own with extensions.worktreeConfig
